{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794700950183,"sessionID":"ses_e23871b81ffelsi65it4Ik8b7X","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"J8tzPUcBBRb14Iw0","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","content":"import math\n\nresearch = [\"e04\", \"e08\", \"e15\", \"e20\", \"e21\", \"e25\", \"e31\", \"e32\", \"e33\", \"e36\"]\nc1_variants = {\n    \"V1\": [\"e03\", \"e04\", \"e07\", \"e08\", \"e11\", \"e15\", \"e36\"],\n    \"V2\": [\"e12\", \"e16\", \"e18\", \"e20\", \"e21\", \"e32\"],\n    \"V3\": [\"e17\", \"e19\", \"e25\", \"e26\", \"e31\", \"e33\"],\n}\n\n# Access logs days 1..4 for Research employees (all 10 held docs on days 1..4)\nlogs = [\n    # Day 1\n    (\"e04\", True), (\"e04\", False), (\"e04\", False),\n    (\"e08\", False),\n    (\"e20\", False), (\"e20\", False),\n    (\"e25\", False),\n    (\"e31\", False),\n    (\"e32\", False),\n    (\"e33\", False), (\"e33\", False),\n    # Day 2\n    (\"e04\", False), (\"e04\", False), (\"e04\", False),\n    (\"e15\", False),\n    (\"e25\", False),\n    (\"e36\", False), (\"e36\", True), (\"e36\", False),\n    # Day 3\n    (\"e04\", False),\n    (\"e08\", False),\n    (\"e20\", True),\n    (\"e21\", False),\n    (\"e25\", False), (\"e25\", False), (\"e25\", False), (\"e25\", True),\n    (\"e31\", True),\n    (\"e33\", False),\n    # Day 4\n    (\"e04\", False), (\"e04\", False), (\"e04\", False),\n    (\"e08\", False),\n    (\"e15\", True),\n    (\"e20\", False), (\"e20\", False), (\"e20\", True),\n    (\"e21\", False),\n    (\"e25\", False), (\"e25\", False), (\"e25\", False),\n    (\"e31\", False),\n    (\"e32\", False), (\"e32\", False),\n    (\"e33\", False), (\"e33\", False), (\"e33\", False),\n]\n\n# Interviews: True = evasive, False = cooperative\ninterviews = [\n    (\"e04\", False), (\"e04\", True),\n    (\"e08\", True), (\"e08\", True),\n    (\"e15\", False),\n    (\"e20\", False), (\"e20\", True),\n    (\"e25\", False),\n    (\"e36\", True),\n]\n\n# Compute log-likelihood for each Research candidate being the mole\n# For days 1..4 (4 days):\n# Mole: daytime ~ Poisson(0.70/day), after_hours ~ Poisson(0.30/day) (never framed)\n# Innocent non-decoy: daytime ~ Poisson(0.90/day), after_hours ~ Poisson(0.10 + framing_other/day)\n# On day 1, 19 non-decoy held docs (decoy e27 held 0); wait: framing picks decoy w/ 0.5, else 1 of 38 random non-mole non-decoy, so each non-mole non-decoy gets Poisson(1.0/38 = 0.0263)/day (plus maybe 1/39 if DSL frames random colleague).\nlam_ah_mole = 0.30\nlam_day_mole = 0.70\nlam_ah_inn = 0.10 + 1.0 / 38.0\nlam_day_inn = 0.90\n\nah_counts = {e: 0 for e in research}\nday_counts = {e: 0 for e in research}\nfor e, ah in logs:\n    if ah:\n        ah_counts[e] += 1\n    else:\n        day_counts[e] += 1\n\nev_counts = {e: 0 for e in research}\ncoop_counts = {e: 0 for e in research}\nfor e, ev in interviews:\n    if ev:\n        ev_counts[e] += 1\n    else:\n        coop_counts[e] += 1\n\nscores = {}\nfor m in research:\n    # c1 = V1 likelihood\n    ll = math.log(0.95 if m in c1_variants[\"V1\"] else 0.025)\n    # Logs likelihood ratio of m vs innocent\n    # Only m's terms differ from all-innocent baseline:\n    k_ah = ah_counts[m]\n    k_day = day_counts[m]\n    # Poisson(4*lam_mole) / Poisson(4*lam_inn)\n    ll += -4 * (lam_ah_mole - lam_ah_inn) + k_ah * math.log(lam_ah_mole / lam_ah_inn)\n    ll += -4 * (lam_day_mole - lam_day_inn) + k_day * math.log(lam_day_mole / lam_day_inn)\n    # Interviews LR: evasive = 0.24 / 0.20 = 1.2; coop = 0.76 / 0.80 = 0.95\n    ll += ev_counts[m] * math.log(0.24 / 0.20) + coop_counts[m] * math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n    scores[m] = ll\n\nmax_ll = max(scores.values())\nweights = {e: math.exp(scores[e] - max_ll) for e in research}\ntotal = sum(weights.values())\npost = {e: weights[e] / total for e in research}\n\nfor e in sorted(research, key=lambda x: -post[x]):\n    v = [k for k, vals in c1_variants.items() if e in vals][0]\n    print(f\"{e}: post={post[e]:.4f} (c1={v}, ah={ah_counts[e]}, day={day_counts[e]}, ev={ev_counts[e]}, coop={coop_counts[e]})\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker.py","time":{"start":1794700950174,"end":1794700950181}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc833a98001331ATI5CI2S8d3","sessionID":"ses_e23871b81ffelsi65it4Ik8b7X","messageID":"msg_1dc820dfb001zHXznm9zow6s4I"}}
